Feature Flags.description: Control feature availability without an app release.

feature_help_requests_enabled.description: Show/hide the help requests flow for all users. UX gate only — backend still enforces access.

feature_audio_upload_enabled.description: Enable/disable audio upload. Set false to suppress the feature globally without a release.

feature_location_capture_enabled.description: Enable/disable foreground location capture and permission request.

feature_push_registration_enabled.description: Enable/disable FCM token registration. Set false for emergency suppression or backend instability.

Auth Flags.description: Control login method availability. UX only — backend validates all tokens.

auth_phone_otp_enabled.description: Show OTP phone login option. UX only — backend validates tokens regardless.

auth_google_enabled.description: Show Google Sign-In option. UX only — backend validates tokens regardless.

auth_google_require_phone.description: Require phone number collection after Google sign-in.

UI and Content.description: Dynamic strings and banners without a release.

home_banner_enabled.description: Show a dismissable announcement banner on the home screen.

home_banner_title.description: Title text for the home screen banner. Only shown when home_banner_enabled is true.

home_banner_message.description: Body text for the home screen banner. Only shown when home_banner_enabled is true.

support_contact_whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number for support contact (e.g. +919876543210). Empty hides the WhatsApp link.

support_contact_email.description: Email address for support contact. Empty hides the email link.

feature_help_requests_disabled_message.description: Message shown when help requests are temporarily disabled. Empty falls back to app-local copy.

maintenance_mode_enabled.description: Show full-screen maintenance gate to all users. Set maintenance_message first before enabling.

maintenance_message.description: Message shown on maintenance screen. Falls back to hardcoded default if empty.

min_supported_app_version_android.description: Minimum supported Android version (semver). Raise above current build to trigger force update. Requires force_update_enabled=true.

min_supported_app_version_ios.description: Minimum supported iOS version (semver). Raise above current build to trigger force update. Requires force_update_enabled=true.

force_update_enabled.description: Additional gate for force update — must be true AND version below minimum. Prevents a single mis-click from blocking all users.

audio_upload_use_presigned.description: Use S3 presigned PUT for audio upload (true) or server-buffered chunked upload (false).

help_request_poll_interval_ms.description: Transcription polling interval in milliseconds. Clamped app-side to [5000, 60000].

remote_config_fetch_interval_seconds.description: How often the app re-fetches Remote Config (seconds). Clamped app-side to [300, 86400]. Does not apply in dev builds.

analytics_debug_logging_enabled.description: Enable Analytics collection in dev/debug builds for DebugView output. Never enable in production.

crashlytics_user_context_enabled.description: Attach user ID and attributes to crash reports. Set false for privacy-sensitive regions or user opt-out.

Debug Flags.description: Dev and staging only. Both require __DEV__ app-side guard — never enable in production.

mock_nearby_enabled.description: Use mock nearby tasks instead of real API. App-side guard also requires __DEV__. Never enable in production Console.

mock_upload_create_enabled.description: Use mock upload/create API client. App-side guard also requires __DEV__. Never enable in production Console.
